reason: The cited evidence shows precipitation strengthening within phases (L12 in fcc, E1) and hierarchical nano-lamellar structures from annealing (E2), but neither demonstrates selective interphase film precipitation at colony boundaries nor links such films to improved boundary cohesion and ductility. The key premises about boundary film formation and its dual effect on strength and ductility are unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Short-time annealing can precipitate interphase films at colony boundaries in eutectic HEAs
These films will be thin, coherent, and of B2 or L12 type
Such films enhance local cohesion and strength of colony boundaries
The films contribute to overall precipitation strengthening
The combined effects simultaneously improve yield strength and room-temperature tensile ductility
